arguments.sql:
SELECT t.rtype, COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS addresses_matched,
       COUNT(f."School Code") AS codes_matched, MIN(f."School Code") AS min_code,
       COUNT(t.NumGE1500) AS numerators, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TYPEOF(t.NumGE1500)) AS numerator_types,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT TYPEOF(t.NumTstTakr)) AS taker_types, MIN(t.sname) AS example_name
FROM main.satscores AS t
LEFT JOIN main.schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
LEFT JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr >= 700
GROUP BY t.rtype

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM main.satscores AS t
JOIN main.schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
JOIN main.frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.rtype = 'S'
  AND t.NumTstTakr >= 700
  AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC,
         CAST(f."School Code" AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1
